Name: (CP) Custom Basketball
Author: Dingtrue114
Description:
This mod adds a fun new item—Kunkun's Basketball—to Stardew Valley! The orange-themed basic item is available at Pierre’s Seed Shop for 500g (sells for 250g; note: the price rises to 1000g after Pierre increases his shop prices) and is non-edible (-300 edibility).

Key features:

[list]
[*]Toggle the mod on/off via the [code]Enable_Mod[/code] config (default: true).
[*]Full support for English and Simplified Chinese.
[*]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to run.
[/list]
If the item doesn’t appear in the shop, check the [code]Enable_Mod[/code] setting or restart the game. If the mod fails to load, ensure you have the latest SMAPI/Content Patcher and no conflicting UniqueIDs. This mod is for entertainment only and won’t damage save files.

本模组为《星露谷物语》新增趣味物品「坤坤的篮球」！这款橙色主题基础物品可在皮埃尔种子商店以 500 金购买（出售可得 250 金；注：皮埃尔商店涨价后，该物品售价会变为 1000 金），不可食用（可食用性 - 300）。

核心特点：

[list]
[*]可通过[code]Enable_Mod[/code]配置项开关模组（默认开启）；
[*]支持英语、简体中文双语；
[*]需安装 SMAPI 和 Content Patcher 才能运行。
[/list]
若物品未出现在商店，检查[code]Enable_Mod
[/code]设置或重启游戏；若模组加载失败，确认 SMAPI/Content Patcher 为最新版本且无 UniqueID 冲突。本模组仅作娱乐用途，不会损坏存档。
